label: Aristotle, Categories V, 2a11-19; conceptual…: Something is a primary substance exactly when it is…
interpretation: Definitional reading: primary substance is exactly what is neither said of a subject nor in a subject. The two source relations are left primitive; in particular, the claim does not identify them with modern predication, inherence, parthood, or dependence. The individual-human and individual-horse examples remain illustrative rather than a theory of individuals.
